name: Pressure Wash Simulator
desc:
Welcome to Roblox Pressure Washing Simulator, the most satisfying simulator game on Roblox! In this power washing tycoon and simulator, you can roleplay as a power washer with your friends, from cleaning vans to cars, houses, gardens and more! 

Upgrade your power wash guns for better pressure to wash more efficiently especially with larger nozzles! More pressure takes more water from the tank, so make sure to upgrade your tanks too!

📝UPDATE LOG:
- 10 New Cleanable Areas in a new world!

👍LIKE THE GAME FOR NEW UPDATES!👍

Follow the game to know when there's a new update so you don't miss out!

Made with ❤️ by
Sub & Fluff

Special thanks to FallenAngel, Jaka, BlueGrass and Starmaq! Inspired by Power Wash Simulator on Steam! 
Post bugs & suggestions in the group below!

scripts.title: Auto Refill
scripts.features:
Auto Refill

How to use: if you want to stop it then turn AutoRefill on false, for example: AutoRefill = true, if you want to turn it off do AutoRefill = false.
scripts.script:
_G.AutoRefill = true -- Set true to false to turn off
game:GetService("RunService").RenderStepped:Connect(function() if _G.AutoRefill == true then game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage").Remotes.RefillRemote:FireServer(true)end end)
